about.en: Monash University, established in 1958, is one of Australia's premier recognized universities, holding a prominent global position (Rank 37 QS World University Rankings 2025 (Australia Group of Eight Go8)). The university delivers world-class academic education and cutting-edge research in close collaboration with leading global industries, offering international students a dynamic multicultural campus and exceptional graduate career prospects.
